components.label: api
responsibilities: Housekeeping on a whole store directory, for the maintenance use case.
forbidden_responsibilities: Saving or loading a single order, and knowing the document format.

requires.rationale: Compaction walks the stored files and deletes them, which is the only knowledge of the directory layout it is allowed to hold.

components.label: backend
responsibilities: Where a document lives, how it is named, and how it is read and replaced.
forbidden_responsibilities: Interpreting what a document contains, and knowing about orders at all.

components.label: codec
responsibilities: The stored document format and the version stamped into it.
forbidden_responsibilities: Touching the filesystem, and deciding where a document is written.

components.label: repository
responsibilities: The order-facing persistence API the rest of the shop is written against.
forbidden_responsibilities: Formatting a document itself, and reaching the filesystem without the backend.

requires.rationale: An order is stored somewhere, and the place it is stored is settled in one module rather than at every call site.
Turning an order into bytes and back is a format decision the persistence API delegates, so the format can change without the API changing.

rules.rationale: Inside the store the same principle holds as above it: an import nobody asked for is an accident, so each part names what it needs and absence refuses the rest.
